reachability: External `pure` (DefaultFeeRouter.sol:23) with no storage and no calls, so it is callable by anyone and can only return numbers. It is reached from the hook's fee path only if the timelock points `feeRouter` (CauldronHook.sol:1277) at this contract; the hook then calls it inside a try/catch at `route` (CauldronHook.sol:1279) and discards the result unless the three parts sum exactly to the fee. `toGuild` (DefaultFeeRouter.sol:26) and `toFloor` (DefaultFeeRouter.sol:28) are floor-divided by the constant, and `toRelaunch` (DefaultFeeRouter.sol:29) takes the remainder so the sum is exact by construction.
